metadata.title: Expensia – Expense Tracker for iPhone
metadata.description: Track one-time and recurring expenses, understand spending, set budgets, save receipts, and export reports with Expensia for iPhone.

hero.title: See where your money goes
hero.subtitle: Track one-time and recurring expenses, spot spending patterns, and stay in control without turning money management into another job.

features.label: Features
features.title: Built for everyday expenses
features.subtitle: Everything important stays quick, clear, and close at hand.

capture.title: Capture without friction
capture.description: Save an expense in seconds, then find it again without digging.

automate.title: Let routine costs run
automate.description: Schedule recurring costs and keep current spending close on every signed-in iPhone.

understand.title: Understand the month
understand.description: See useful trends and optional category limits without turning tracking into accounting.

keep.title: Keep what matters
keep.description: Attach private receipts and take clean records with you when needed.

expenseEntry.title: Fast expense entry
expenseEntry.description: Name an expense, choose one of nine categories, set the date, and save it in seconds.

recurring.title: Recurring costs, handled
recurring.description: Schedule bills and subscriptions, then pause, resume, edit, or delete them whenever needed.

insights.title: Clear spending insights
insights.description: Review monthly totals, category breakdowns, a six-month trend, and a selected month at a glance.

organize.title: Find every expense fast
organize.description: Search names and filter charges or recurring schedules by category and date.

budgets.title: Monthly category budgets
budgets.description: Set category limits and follow progress without blocking expense entry.

receipts.title: Private receipt photos
receipts.description: Attach one camera or library photo to a one-time or generated expense.

export.title: CSV and PDF export
export.description: Take your expense data with you or share a clear one-page summary.

sync.title: Widgets and cloud sync
sync.description: See current-month spending from your Home Screen and keep signed-in iPhones in sync.

plans.label: Free & Pro
plans.title: Start free. Upgrade when useful.
plans.subtitle: Core tracking stays useful for free; Pro removes limits and unlocks advanced tools.

free.title: Everyday tracking
free.generated: Generated recurring charges do not use the monthly limit
free.included: Dashboard, Insights, widgets, categories, and cloud sync

pro.title: More control, no limits
pro.export: CSV data export and PDF summaries

showcase.label: App showcase
showcase.title: See Expensia in action
showcase.subtitle: Current screens from the app in six languages.

add.title: Fast entry
add.alt: Adding an expense and receipt in Expensia

about.title: Expense tracking without the clutter
about.description: Expensia is intentionally small: one-time expenses, recurring costs, and the tools that make both easier to understand. Available in six languages for iPhone.

footer.description: Your personal expense tracker for iPhone.
